title: What the delegating party learns at a gate is whatever reaches its own context
situation: Realizing attach on omp, the lead found two narrow paths where a reply held at a gate is kept in the delegating agent's stored transcript, never shown to its model while live but open to the harness's compaction summary, which that model later reads; closing them has a cost to every session. Its reviewer and the lead read 'learns only' differently.
decision: 'Learns only' binds whatever reaches the delegating party's own context, by any route: a delivered result, a message, or a summary it later reads. A record the harness keeps that the party never reads is not learning. The delegating party takes no part in a gate held for the operator, so it does not message a delegate waiting there. Where a harness cannot hold this, whether to pay the cost of closing the gap is the lead's realization choice; a gap left open is a shortfall against the meaning, recorded and reported as such, never read as the meaning being met.
consequences: The gate concept states this. Whether a projection leaves the gap open is the lead's to settle and report.
